add_new_model: add a new model to the LiteLLM proxy with name, litellm_params, and optional model_info
delete_model: delete a model from the LiteLLM proxy database by its model_id
update_public_model_groups: update which model groups are publicly accessible in the LiteLLM proxy
update_useful_links: update useful links for the public model hub in the LiteLLM proxy
patch_model: partially update a model in the LiteLLM proxy database by model_id with only specified fields
